biocontainers.name: bioconductor-phosr
biocontainers.summary: A set of methods and tools for comprehensive analysis of phosphoproteomics data

biotools.summary: PhosR is a package for the comprenhensive analysis of phosphoproteomic data. There are two major components to PhosR: processing and downstream analysis. PhosR consists of various processing tools for phosphoproteomics data including filtering, imputation, normalisation, and functional analysis for inferring active kinases and signalling pathways.
